newsitem.title: GREECE: Bomb explodes outside Peru embassy in Athens - police.
newsitem.headline: Bomb explodes outside Peru embassy in Athens - police.

text.p: A bomb exploded outside the premises of the Peruvian embassy in Athens on Monday, causing slight damage but no injuries, police said.
They said the bomb had been planted outside the door of the apartment in central Athens where the embassy is located. "It caused slight damage but no injuries or casualties," a police spokesman said.
No individual or group had yet claimed responsibility for the blast, the spokesman added.

Marxist rebels of the Tupac Amaru Revolutionary Movement (MRTA) have been holding 83 hostages at the Japanese ambassador's home in Lima since December 17 and are pressing for improved conditions for jailed comrades and recognition of their movement.
